nodes.text: @Bishnoi_Bos Doctors are using social media and humor to spread awareness about the HMPV virus, easing fears with relatable content. Dr. Jagdish Chaturvedi's playful posts clarify that HMPV isn't as dangerous as COVID-19 and mostly affects people with respiratory conditions.
